fact: ANCy held a pre-validation workshop on 23 October 2022 to collect amendments from public and private institutions on the national cybersecurity strategy, then a validation workshop on 23-25 November 2022 with about thirty representatives of public and private institutions.
title: Du mercredi 23 au vendredi 25 novembre 2022 s’était tenu l’atelier de validation de la stratégie nationale de la cybersécurité avec la participation des institutions nationales
